NVDA.text: Nvidia fell 2.9% as semiconductors sold off ahead of its Aug. 26 earnings, with investors also weighing AI-spending concerns and political opposition to new data centers; no separate Nvidia-specific negative catalyst was confirmed.

AVGO.text: Broadcom fell 2.6% with Monday's broad semiconductor selloff as investors reduced AI-chip exposure ahead of Nvidia earnings; no fresh Broadcom-specific catalyst was confirmed.

TSM.text: TSM fell 2.1% with the semiconductor group as traders trimmed chip exposure ahead of Nvidia earnings; no fresh TSM-specific catalyst was confirmed.

ASML.text: ASML fell 1.3% in a broad chip-equipment and semiconductor risk-off move ahead of Nvidia earnings; no fresh ASML-specific catalyst was confirmed.

KLAC.text: KLA fell 1.3% with Monday's semiconductor selloff as investors reduced AI-hardware exposure ahead of Nvidia earnings; no fresh KLA-specific catalyst was confirmed.

INTC.text: Intel fell 3.1% as semiconductor shares sold off broadly ahead of Nvidia earnings, with no fresh Intel-specific catalyst confirmed Monday.

MU.text: Micron fell 5.8% and was among the weakest major chip names as investors cut AI and memory exposure ahead of Nvidia earnings; no fresh Micron-specific catalyst was confirmed.

TSLA.text: Tesla fell 3.8% as new U.S. tariff plans pressured automakers and the company faced a 2.98-million-vehicle China recall, reversing part of Friday's robotaxi-driven gain.

META.text: Meta rose 1.7% despite a weaker Nasdaq, with no fresh single company catalyst confirmed; the move appears to reflect relative strength in its advertising and AI-engagement narrative rather than the semiconductor-led selloff.

PLTR.text: Palantir fell 2.3% after a strong prior-session gain as growth stocks weakened with the Nasdaq; no fresh Palantir-specific catalyst was confirmed Monday.

SPCX.text: SpaceX fell 1.4% in a weaker growth-stock tape; no fresh company-specific negative catalyst was confirmed Monday, and the stock remained volatile after recent lockup-supply concerns.
